{{Top|leg|title=Unidentified ''Aegis''-class combat shuttle}}
{{Conjecture|legends}}
An '''''Aegis''-class combat shuttle''' was assigned to the [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]] ''[[FarStar]]'' during its [[DarkStryder Campaign|mission]] to track down the rogue [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]], [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Kentor Sarne]]. It was one of two vessels assigned to the ship, alongside the [[Loronar Corporation/Legends|Loronar Corporation]] [[B-7 light freighter]] ''[[Muvon]]''.
